a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to build to 8 first will very likely leave us both dead after round 1. So I intend to take 4 in round 1, even though that breaks our agreement. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you'd rather propose another split, tell me, but this is my planned move.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round because the storm odds make waiting very likely fatal. If I end up with more than 4, I'll give the extra back. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so you can reach 4.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
